cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A name that is permanent, unchanging, and essential to the nature of something; a true or ultimate designation.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies a name that transcends temporal and conventional limitations.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the eternal Way; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The state of not existing or lacking form; the void or emptiness prior to creation.
cards.Nuance (English): Used in contrast with 'being' to denote the primordial condition before differentiation.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): Non-being is the beginning of heaven and earth; being is the mother of all things.
cards.Sentences: S無名，天地之始，有名，萬物之母。
